inscription: No. 970 / Berceuse / Op. 26. Nr. 7. / Ludwig Schytte / Gespielt von [facsimile signature] / 5. XII. 05.
notes: crops 1-4 show only tears, a repair patch, a crease and bare red paper. Crop 5 is the leader with the printed Welte title label, which carries No. 970 and the printed date 5. XII. 05. That is the label's date, printed with the rest of the label and not pencilled by the workshop, so I have left date_iso null rather than pass it off as a punch date. The performer's name is a facsimile signature I cannot read with confidence. No handwritten date on the paper

notes: no punch date on any of the three crops. Crop 1 carries WATCH in a modern black marker, crop 2 the green box with the printed label «WELTE-MIGNON. No. 990, Meistersinger von Nürnberg, Vorspiel, Wagner-Bülow, Gespielt von [signature]», crop 3 a long English note in fine pen by a later owner or conservator, dated 2 8 198? with the century written out; the last figure of the year is not certain.
